```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import sys
from pathlib import Path

# Ensure root-level modules (scripts/) are importable in both Quarto run contexts.
cwd = Path.cwd()
project_root = cwd if (cwd / "scripts").exists() else cwd.parent
if str(project_root) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))

# Convention: keep the workbook at data/raw/workbook.xlsx.
CHA_WORKBOOK_PATH = project_root / "data" / "raw" / "workbook.xlsx"
```

## How this works

The figure and table below are **not hand-written**. They come from
`data/raw/workbook.xlsx`, which uses the same format as the Mid-Hudson CHA workbook:

- A **`Master`** sheet - the roster of every indicator (Activate/Deactivate,
  `Object_Type`, `Indicator Name`, `Object ID`, `Figure ID`, data source).
- A **`Dropdowns`** sheet - reference lists for the data-entry dropdowns
  (format codes, y-labels, sources, dates, ...).
- One sheet **per indicator** with a config block in columns A/B (`Name`,
  `Table/Figure/Both`, `Object ID`, `Figure Type`, `X Column`, ...) and the data
  entered to the right of the `Enter Data` cell.

On every `quarto render`, the `pre-render` hook in `_quarto.yml` runs
`scripts/generate_chapter_objects.py`, which reads the indicator sheets and writes one
include file per object into `chapters/_generated/objects/`. This chapter pulls them in.

The `Pop in Poverty` sheet is a figure (@fig-poverty-pop); the companion table is
@tbl-poverty-pop.

{{< include _generated/objects/fig-poverty-pop.qmd >}}

{{< include _generated/objects/tbl-poverty-pop.qmd >}}

## To add your own indicator

1. Copy an indicator sheet (`Poverty Rate` or `Total Households`).
2. Set the config cells in column A/B - especially `Name`, `Table/Figure/Both`
   (figure **or** table), `Object ID`, and (for figures) `Figure Type` / `X Column`.
3. Fill the data to the right of the `Enter Data` cell: the row-label column (col F)
   plus value columns, with per-column format codes in the row just above.
4. Add the indicator to the `Master` roster (optional, for tracking).
5. Reference it in any chapter with `{{< include _generated/objects/<object_id>.qmd >}}`
   (e.g. `fig-<id>` or `tbl-<id>`), run the generator once, then `quarto render`.

See `scripts/WORKBOOK_SCHEMA.md` and `scripts/PIPELINE_USAGE.md` for full details.
